Definition: from G4314 and G2038; to work additionally, i.e. (by implication) acquire besides:--gain.
BiblicalUsage: Prosergazomai means to gain besides, to work and add to what was given. It appears once, in the parable of the pounds: the first servant came, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained ten pounds.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the servant's gain was not his own cleverness but his faithfulness with a small trust, and the Master rewards it the same way.
